name: Scripting (Bash & Python)
description: Automation scripting using Bash and Python for task automation, system administration, and DevOps workflows.

subskills.name: Bash Scripting Fundamentals
subskills.description: Variables, control structures (if/else, loops), functions, exit codes, and script structure.

subskills.name: Text Processing & Pipelines
subskills.description: Using grep, sed, awk, and piping for data transformation and log analysis.

subskills.name: Python Scripting Fundamentals
subskills.description: Python basics for automation: file I/O, string manipulation, modules, and error handling.

subskills.name: API Interaction & HTTP Requests
subskills.description: Using curl, wget, or Python requests library to interact with REST APIs.

subskills.name: File System Automation
subskills.description: Automating file operations: backup, cleanup, log rotation, and bulk processing.

subskills.name: Error Handling & Logging
subskills.description: Robust error handling, exit codes, logging to files, and notification mechanisms.

subskills.name: Regular Expressions
subskills.description: Pattern matching for text extraction, validation, and transformation.

subskills.name: Custom CLI Tool Development
subskills.description: Building custom CLI utilities with argument parsing, subcommands, and structured output.

subskills.name: Script Testing, Linting & Packaging
subskills.description: Writing automated tests for scripts, static analysis/linting, and packaging for distribution.

github.signal: Bash scripts (.sh) with proper shebang and structure
API interaction code (requests, curl in scripts)
Text processing with grep/sed/awk in scripts

assessment.signal: Can write a Bash script to automate a system task
Can write a Python script to interact with a REST API

junior.description: Can write basic Bash and Python scripts for task automation, text processing, and file management.

mid.description: Can write robust scripts with error handling, API interaction, and complex text processing.

senior.description: Can design and maintain complex automation frameworks, build custom CLI tools with argument parsing, test and package scripts for production distribution.
